title: MPESB Nursing Officer, Sister Tutor Syllabus 2026
vacancyDetails: Exam syllabus and pattern for Nursing Officer / Sister Tutor
documentsRequired: Download official syllabus PDF from portal
howToApply:
1. Visit https://esb.mp.gov.in
2. Open Syllabus / Notification PDF
3. Download MPESB Nursing Officer, Sister Tutor Syllabus 2026
4. Note exam pattern and marking scheme
5. Prepare topic-wise as per official units
shortDescription: MPESB Nursing Officer and Sister Tutor Syllabus 2026 – nursing subjects overview.
content:
MPESB Nursing Officer / Sister Tutor exams focus on professional nursing subjects as per GNM / B.Sc Nursing curriculum level.

Major topics

  • Fundamentals of Nursing
  • Medical-Surgical Nursing
  • Community Health Nursing
  • Midwifery & Obstetrical Nursing
  • Pediatric / Psychiatric Nursing basics
  • Nursing education / administration (for Sister Tutor level)

Download official scheme from esb.mp.gov.in.
